preregistered_resolution.class_word_tension: ALLOW/DENY/ABSTAIN are permitted only inside the episode-local [CODEBOOK] span. Exact class labels are forbidden in [CASE], [QUERY] and target output. Hidden source metadata may retain the class for deterministic auditing but is not model input.
preregistered_resolution.counterbalance_law: Within every template, all three target classes occur equally and every class-to-symbol pair occurs exactly twice across the six S3 mappings.
preregistered_resolution.holdout_law: The frozen unseen template is absent from both TRAIN and VALIDATION. HOLDOUT atom indices are disjoint from TRAIN and VALIDATION.
preregistered_resolution.materialization_law: Pre-materialized rows use {{ABI:NN}} accepted-alphabet indices and MUST remain model_consumable=false until the exact accepted 46-atom table, ABI membership and exact measured tokenizer single-token property are reverified.
preregistered_resolution.permutation_law: Each template realizes all six S3 class-to-symbol permutations causally in the rendered codebook; permutation metadata is derived from the same mapping used to render prompt and target.
preregistered_resolution.split_law: Family, provenance ancestry, template identity, semantic-bearing lexical inventory and accepted-atom index pools are isolated across TRAIN/VALIDATION/HOLDOUT.
